reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper is a review article and does not report primary genotype data.

african_field_population.evidence: The paper is a review article and does not report primary data from field-caught mosquitoes.

assessment.summary: This is a review article discussing the history and efficacy of insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) and long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) in Africa. It does not report primary empirical data on insecticide-resistance markers.
